about: X2 evaluator commands per platform (fix round 2026-10-06; fix round 2 the same day). Templates only: no absolute paths. Set HM_REPO to the heimdall repository root and HM_HIDDEN to this directory before running; copy these templates, never expanded command lines, into evidence. Never give any of this to an implementer. Placeholders: {task} T1..T4, {lang} go|rust, {ws} the cell's workspace (make-workspace.sh), {eval} the evaluator's scratch directory for the cell (outside every workspace), {sha_darwin} / {sha_linux} the sha256 of the frozen build's darwin-arm64 / linux-arm64 heimdall-proto. Every pack Python runs with -I -B (no __pycache__, which would embed the home path). Scratch for the pack author and reviewers is $HM_HIDDEN/../r4-scratch; /tmp/hm-r4 no longer exists.

steps.expect: verify-matrix.sh exits 2 if HM_REPO/tests/g02 differs from BASE.json support_commit; otherwise exit-codes.tsv shows T4 seeded-* exit 1 and base-* exit 0 with sha256_12 equal to BASE.json

exit 0; --dest is resolved (relative made absolute, . and .. refused, nearest existing ancestor resolved with pwd -P) and refused before anything is created if it lies inside the repository, $HM_HIDDEN/.. (hidden dir and r4-scratch) or /tmp/hm-r4. The implementer gets only the --dest path and the instruction to read TASK.md; start it with that path as its working directory if the runner allows (otherwise every call made before it cds into the workspace is flagged by the audit)

steps.when: after the implementer finishes, before evaluation
steps.expect: VERDICT CLEAN, exit 0. VERDICT SUSPECT, exit 1: inspect the listed call indices by hand (reason codes say why: cwd-outside, path-outside, glob-outside, unresolved-expansion, unparsed-command, marker, output-marker) and record whether the cell is contaminated. Self-test: python3 -I -B "$HM_HIDDEN/audit-selftest.py" --repo "$HM_REPO" --scratch "$HM_HIDDEN/../r4-scratch/audit-selftest"
evaluation never reads the live workspace again

steps.cmd: T1-T3: git -C "$HM_REPO" archive <BASE.json base.{lang}.commit> prototypes/{lang} | tar -x -C {eval}/base; T4: mkdir -p {eval}/base/prototypes && cp -R "$HM_HIDDEN/<BASE.json seed.{lang}.tree>" {eval}/base/prototypes/{lang}; then diff -ruN -x target -x dist {eval}/base/prototypes/{lang} {eval}/frozen/{lang} > {eval}/change.patch
steps.expect: the implementer's change; check the base copy's tree digest against BASE.json first
exit 0, all four targets incl. windows-x64; record sha256 of dist/darwin-arm64/heimdall-proto and dist/linux-arm64/heimdall-proto
exit 0 all pass, 1 a check failed, 2 setup/invalid (rerun, do not score)
as above; the container sees only the hidden dir, a private copy of the binary and the output dir

exit 0 and valid=true; --expect-sha256 is required and must equal the record's binary_sha256 and binary_sha256_after, and the record's lang must equal --lang. Report all_pass, fixed, regressed (T1: compare languages by these, not by raw pass counts). T2.ascii_fold_only counts toward all_pass for both languages (orchestrator decision, README)

steps.cmd: python3 -I -B "$HM_HIDDEN/scan-home.py" <everything about to be copied into $HM_REPO/tests/evidence>
steps.expect: exit 0; never copy a file with a hit

steps.when: last, after evidence-scan and after the reviewer's artifacts are in {eval}/out
steps.expect: exit 0; {eval}/out holds dist-frozen/ (the evaluator's build, all targets), dist-workspace/ (the implementer's last build, if any) and SHA256SUMS; Rust target/ directories (except target/tools) and Go build/module caches inside {ws} and {eval} are deleted; sources, change.patch and records are kept. The host disk is nearly full: never skip this step
